name: kwtSMS
description: Send SMS and one-time codes (OTP) in Kuwait and worldwide with kwtSMS
author: kwtSMS

envVars.name: KWTSMS_USERNAME
envVars.description: kwtSMS API username (API page of your account, not your website login)

files._dot_env.local.append.ejs:
# kwtSMS: API username and password from the API page of your kwtSMS account (not your website login)
KWTSMS_USERNAME=
KWTSMS_PASSWORD=
# The Sender ID people see. KWT-SMS is for testing only; use your own registered Sender ID.
KWTSMS_SENDER_ID=KWT-SMS
# 1 = test mode: messages are queued, never delivered. Set 0 to send for real.
KWTSMS_TEST_MODE=1
# Country code added to local 8-digit numbers
KWTSMS_DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE=965
# Signs one-time codes. Generated for this project; keep it secret.
KWTSMS_OTP_SECRET=<%= globalThis.crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '') + globalThis.crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '') %>
# Country codes that may receive one-time codes (comma list). Stops SMS pumping to other countries.
KWTSMS_OTP_ALLOWED_PREFIXES=965
# 1 = read the client IP from X-Forwarded-For (only when your app runs behind your own proxy or host)
KWTSMS_TRUST_PROXY=0
